controls.rule_and_enforcement: A verified credential denies new admission for every trust classification, source checkout, service/job image, reuse and promotion. Failed/malformed scans deny.
controls.limitations: Blocking in upgraded workflows; old pinned application workflows need upgrades. No raw credential evidence. Recovery is a distinct action.
controls.owner_and_evidence: Security/platform; `leaks.py`, `secret_admission.py`, workflow jobs, sanitized admission artifacts and readiness policy tests

controls.rule_and_enforcement: Provenance binds pushed digests; release verifies GitHub or Cosign/KMS provenance.
controls.limitations: Implemented; operator exceptions and effective installation modes must be recorded.
controls.owner_and_evidence: Security; provenance receipts, workflow settings and KMS/IAM evidence

controls.limitations: Implemented; some scans are informational or conditional. A scan's presence is not proof of blocking.
controls.owner_and_evidence: Security; scanner reports, workflow variables, SBOM and vulnerability policy
Security/cloud; effective policy export and denial drill

controls.rule_and_enforcement: Contracts constrain runtime, resource size, scaling, needs, exposure and permitted destinations.
controls.limitations: Blocking in planning/runners; protected policy review is an installation requirement.
controls.owner_and_evidence: Platform; models/enforce, production rules and negative tests

controls.rule_and_enforcement: Independent read-only CI validates central contract data and present locks; retirement requires a reviewed record.
controls.limitations: Implemented workflow; required-check configuration is unknown. A pull_request workflow runs the pull request's own copy, so a pull request that edits contracts.yml can weaken it: the check only binds with required code-owner review of .github/workflows/ (or a ruleset-required workflow). Source-owned locks remain checked by their pipeline.
controls.owner_and_evidence: Platform/repository admin; Contract admission check and branch-protection evidence

controls.rule_and_enforcement: Per-principal application authorization and deployment capability.
controls.limitations: Local principals/OAuth implemented; enterprise identity lifecycle is deferred.
controls.owner_and_evidence: Identity owner; effective principal configuration, access tests and revocation drill

controls.rule_and_enforcement: Cloud workload federation binds repository IDs, owner ID, main, environment and exact workflow.
controls.limitations: Terraform implemented; inherited access and actual trust must be inspected.

controls.rule_and_enforcement: Production copies immutable staging images, uses separate project/environment review and observed rollout steps.
controls.limitations: Implemented; full production gate is specified in PRODUCTION-GATE.md, not claimed as enforced.
controls.owner_and_evidence: Release owner; staging/promotion receipts and reviewer settings

controls.rule_and_enforcement: Durable operation identity/events/outbox precede dispatch; one sender; stale local updates cannot overwrite newer plans.
controls.limitations: Single SQLite writer only; off-host intent enforcement requires `durable_intents`. No automatic resend after uncertainty.
controls.owner_and_evidence: Platform operations; ledger tests, witnessed intents and restart drill

controls.rule_and_enforcement: Restore imports off-host intents as unknown and preserves job quota; admission remains fenced until reconciliation.
controls.limitations: CLI and import implemented; complete listing, old-writer fence and measured backup freshness require a drill.
controls.owner_and_evidence: Platform operations; restore evidence, consistent backup checksum and intent retention policy

controls.rule_and_enforcement: Persistent due times and bounded scheduler lanes reserve follow-up, job guard, watchdog and backup capacity.
controls.limitations: In-process lanes; thread timeout cannot forcibly stop code. Provider calls and reconciliation pages are bounded.
controls.owner_and_evidence: Platform operations; scheduler lag/status, stall tests and pilot load measurements

controls.rule_and_enforcement: Checkpoint generations, heartbeat, exact request identity, pending mutations and conditional traffic updates constrain recovery.
controls.limitations: Unknown mutation/manual drift holds; cannot undo migrations or external side effects. etags are not a cross-resource fence.
controls.owner_and_evidence: Release operations; checkpoint, receipt and interrupted-run tests

controls.rule_and_enforcement: Independent supervisor waits for original runner completion and dispatches the same production queue.
controls.limitations: Opt-in infrastructure/workflow; GitHub outage requires manual recovery. Live timing and alert delivery unverified.
controls.owner_and_evidence: Release operations; supervisor settings, environment/WIF evidence and runner-loss drill

controls.rule_and_enforcement: Dependency hooks execute only in disposable remote workers; controller Docker fallback disabled.
controls.limitations: Workers must be provisioned in separate project. Network/IAM containment needs adversarial live tests. Exception: `resolver_local_fallback: true` runs resolution in the controller's Docker until workers exist; off by default.
controls.owner_and_evidence: Platform/security; pinned worker images, build provenance, effective firewall/IAM and resolver tests

controls.rule_and_enforcement: Registered workload identity, released image/spec, atomic UTC-day/concurrency reservation and idempotency key precede execution.
controls.limitations: Broker implemented; quota is only authoritative after callers lose all direct launch IAM. Unknown outcomes remain charged.
controls.owner_and_evidence: Application/platform owners; broker tests, IAM-denial drill and quota reconciliation

controls.rule_and_enforcement: Compute estimates and optional ceilings reject excessive planned bounds; budget response closes managed workloads.
controls.limitations: Bounds exclude some costs. Notification delay, storage and already-running work prevent a hard zero-overshoot dollar guarantee.
controls.owner_and_evidence: FinOps/platform; measured bill, cap drill and alert owner

controls.rule_and_enforcement: Infrastructure policy guards destructive changes; backups and database recovery settings are declared.
controls.limitations: A traffic rollback does not restore data. Restore correctness and RPO are measured, not inferred.
controls.owner_and_evidence: Data owner; retention, backup/restore drills and change review

controls.rule_and_enforcement: Audit events, release receipts, runtime checks, logs, alerts and operational status expose outcomes.
controls.limitations: Alert recipients/delivery and retention unverified; not a compliance certification or achieved SLO.
controls.owner_and_evidence: Platform/on-call; alert tests, evidence retention and incident records
